interview.name: Mina
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

Hana is organizing the donations and tools workflow and has clearly assigned roles, which suggests she is taking a coordinating lead.
Mina is asking clarifying questions and being given a concrete starting point, so she is likely new to the task and needs operational guidance.

Mina tends to confirm details, ask what is needed, and keep coordination moving with reminders and follow-up.
Faye and Ira are responsive and dependable, agreeing to specific plans and committing to relay information when they learn it.
Mina is coordinating a repair drive and wants location updates immediately from multiple people.
Ira is responsive and willing to help by keeping an ear out while running errands.
Several people are informed but still waiting on the exact repair drive location, so the group is in an information-gathering phase.
Mina is coordinating the repair drive and relies on others for logistics updates.
Noah is responsive but uncertain; he needs reminders and confirmation about the location.
Mara is the most informed participant here, while Pia is helpful but still waiting on details.
